summary.en: From the unification of Upper and Lower Egypt to the Roman annexation after Cleopatra VII — three millennia of pharaonic rule along the Nile.
summary.uz: Yuqori va Quyi Misrning birlashuvidan Kleopatra VII dan so‘ng Rim tomonidan qo‘shib olinishigacha — Nil bo‘yidagi uch ming yillik fir’avnlar hukmronligi.

disputed.en: The exact date of unification is debated; estimates range c. 3200–3000 BCE.
disputed.uz: Birlashuvning aniq sanasi bahsli; taxminlar mil. avv. 3200–3000-yillar oralig‘ida.

political.en: Divine kingship: the pharaoh ruled as intermediary between gods and people, supported by viziers and provincial nomarchs.
political.uz: Ilohiy podsholik: fir’avn xudolar va xalq o‘rtasidagi vositachi sifatida vazirlar va nomarxlar yordamida boshqargan.

economy.en: Irrigated agriculture on the annual Nile flood; grain stored and redistributed by the state.
economy.uz: Nilning yillik toshqiniga tayangan sug‘orma dehqonchilik; g‘alla davlat tomonidan saqlanib, taqsimlangan.

culture.en: Hieroglyphic writing, monumental temples and tombs, an elaborate belief in the afterlife.
culture.uz: Iyeroglif yozuvi, ulkan ibodatxona va maqbaralar, oxiratga oid murakkab e’tiqod.

military.en: Chariot armies of the New Kingdom extended power into the Levant and Nubia.
military.uz: Yangi podsholik davridagi jang aravalari qo‘shini hokimiyatni Levant va Nubiyagacha kengaytirgan.

achievements.en: The pyramids of Giza, a 365-day civil calendar, advances in medicine and surveying.
achievements.uz: Giza ehromlari, 365 kunlik fuqarolik taqvimi, tibbiyot va yer o‘lchash sohasidagi yutuqlar.

decline.en: Foreign rule by Persians and Macedonians; the Ptolemaic line ended with Roman annexation in 30 BCE.
decline.uz: Forslar va makedoniyaliklar hukmronligi; Ptolemeylar sulolasi mil. avv. 30-yilda Rim tomonidan qo‘shib olinishi bilan tugagan.

region.en: Iranian Plateau to the Indus and Aegean
region.uz: Eron yassitog‘idan Hind va Egey dengizigacha

summary.en: Founded by Cyrus the Great, it governed through satrapies and a royal road network, uniting peoples from Egypt to Central Asia.
summary.uz: Kir II (Buyuk Kir) asos solgan saltanat satrapiyalar va shoh yo‘llari orqali Misrdan Markaziy Osiyogacha bo‘lgan xalqlarni birlashtirgan.

political.en: Provinces (satrapies) governed by satraps, linked by the Royal Road and royal inspectors.
political.uz: Satraplar boshqargan viloyatlar (satrapiyalar), Shoh yo‘li va qirol nozirlari orqali bog‘langan.

economy.en: Standardised coinage (the daric), tribute in kind and silver, long-distance trade.
economy.uz: Yagona tanga (darik), natura va kumush shaklidagi soliq, uzoq masofali savdo.

culture.en: Multilingual administration (Old Persian, Elamite, Aramaic); palaces of Persepolis.
culture.uz: Ko‘p tilli boshqaruv (qadimgi fors, elam, oromiy); Persepol saroylari.

military.en: Core of Persian infantry and cavalry with contingents from subject peoples.
military.uz: Fors piyoda va otliq askarlari hamda tobe xalqlar qo‘shinlaridan iborat armiya.

achievements.en: The Royal Road, qanat irrigation, a model of governing diverse peoples.
achievements.uz: Shoh yo‘li, koriz sug‘orish tizimi, turli xalqlarni boshqarish namunasi.

decline.en: Conquered by Alexander of Macedon; Darius III died in 330 BCE.
decline.uz: Makedoniyalik Aleksandr tomonidan bosib olingan; Doro III mil. avv. 330-yilda halok bo‘lgan.

summary.en: From Augustus to the deposition of the last western emperor; its law, roads and Latin shaped Europe long after its fall.
summary.uz: Avgustdan so‘nggi g‘arbiy imperator taxtdan tushirilgunga qadar; uning huquqi, yo‘llari va lotin tili Yevropani asrlar davomida shakllantirdi.

disputed.en: 476 CE marks the end of the Western Empire only; the Eastern (Byzantine) Empire lasted until 1453.
disputed.uz: Milodiy 476-yil faqat G‘arbiy imperiyaning tugashini bildiradi; Sharqiy (Vizantiya) imperiyasi 1453-yilgacha davom etgan.

political.en: An emperor (princeps) ruling alongside a Senate, with provinces under governors.
political.uz: Senat bilan birga hukm surgan imperator (prinseps), viloyatlar esa noiblar boshqaruvida.

economy.en: Mediterranean trade, slavery-based agriculture, a common silver and gold coinage.
economy.uz: O‘rta yer dengizi savdosi, qul mehnatiga asoslangan dehqonchilik, umumiy kumush va oltin tangalar.

culture.en: Latin literature, Roman law, urban life with forums, baths and amphitheatres.
culture.uz: Lotin adabiyoti, Rim huquqi, forum, hammom va amfiteatrlarga ega shahar hayoti.

military.en: Professional legions and auxiliaries guarding fortified frontiers (limes).
military.uz: Mustahkam chegaralarni (limes) qo‘riqlagan professional legionlar va yordamchi qo‘shinlar.

achievements.en: Roads, aqueducts, concrete architecture, a legal tradition still taught today.
achievements.uz: Yo‘llar, akveduklar, beton me’morchiligi, bugungacha o‘qitiladigan huquq an’anasi.

decline.en: Internal crises and migrations; the western empire ended in 476 CE.
decline.uz: Ichki inqirozlar va ko‘chishlar; g‘arbiy imperiya milodiy 476-yilda tugagan.

summary.en: A Silk Road power that connected Han China, Parthia and Rome, and a key patron of Gandharan Buddhist art.
summary.uz: Xan Xitoyi, Parfiya va Rimni bog‘lagan Buyuk ipak yo‘li davlati, Gandxara buddaviy san’atining muhim homiysi.

disputed.en: The chronology of Kanishka's reign is disputed; 127 CE is the most widely cited start.
disputed.uz: Kanishka hukmronligi xronologiyasi bahsli; eng ko‘p keltiriladigan boshlanish sanasi — milodiy 127-yil.

political.en: A monarchy of Yuezhi origin with kings using titles from Greek, Indian and Iranian traditions.
political.uz: Yuechji kelib chiqishli monarxiya; podsholar yunon, hind va eron an’analaridagi unvonlardan foydalangan.

economy.en: Control of Silk Road routes; abundant gold coinage.
economy.uz: Ipak yo‘li yo‘nalishlari ustidan nazorat; ko‘p miqdorda oltin tangalar.

culture.en: Gandharan and Mathura art; spread of Mahayana Buddhism towards Central Asia and China.
culture.uz: Gandxara va Matxura san’ati; Mahayana buddizmining Markaziy Osiyo va Xitoyga tarqalishi.

military.en: Cavalry-based armies drawing on steppe traditions.

achievements.en: Early images of the Buddha; the Rabatak inscription in the Bactrian language.
achievements.uz: Buddaning ilk tasvirlari; baqtriya tilidagi Rabatak bitigi.

decline.en: Lost western territories to the Sasanians in the 3rd century; later fragmented.
decline.uz: III asrda g‘arbiy hududlarini Sosoniylarga boy bergan; keyinroq parchalangan.

region.en: Eurasian steppe, China to Eastern Europe

summary.en: The largest contiguous land empire in history, proclaimed under Genghis Khan in 1206.
summary.uz: Tarixdagi eng yirik yaxlit quruqlik imperiyasi; 1206-yilda Chingizxon boshchiligida e’lon qilingan.

disputed.en: End dates vary: 1294 (fragmentation into khanates) or 1368 (fall of the Yuan).
disputed.uz: Tugash sanasi turlicha: 1294 (xonliklarga bo‘linish) yoki 1368 (Yuan sulolasining qulashi).

political.en: A great khan elected by the kurultai; later divided into the Yuan, Ilkhanate, Chagatai and Golden Horde.
political.uz: Qurultoy saylagan buyuk xon; keyinroq Yuan, Elxoniylar, Chig‘atoy ulusi va Oltin O‘rdaga bo‘lingan.

economy.en: Tribute, protected trade across Eurasia, the yam relay-post system.
economy.uz: O‘lpon, Yevroosiyo bo‘ylab himoyalangan savdo, yam pochta tizimi.

culture.en: Religious tolerance, exchange of artisans and scholars across the empire.
culture.uz: Diniy bag‘rikenglik, imperiya bo‘ylab hunarmand va olimlar almashinuvi.

military.en: Mounted archers in decimal units, mobility and siege expertise from conquered peoples.
military.uz: O‘nlik tizimdagi otliq kamonchilar, harakatchanlik va bosib olingan xalqlardan olingan qamal mahorati.

decline.en: Succession disputes split the empire; the Yuan fell in 1368.
decline.uz: Taxt uchun nizolar imperiyani bo‘lib yuborgan; Yuan 1368-yilda qulagan.

summary.en: Founded by Amir Temur; under Shah Rukh and Ulugh Beg, Samarkand and Herat became centres of astronomy, architecture and Persianate art.
summary.uz: Amir Temur asos solgan; Shohrux va Ulug‘bek davrida Samarqand va Hirot astronomiya, me’morchilik va san’at markazlariga aylandi.

political.en: Rule by Timur's descendants as amirs and sultans, legitimised through Chinggisid marriage ties.
political.uz: Temur avlodlari amir va sultonlar sifatida hukm surgan; chingiziylar bilan qarindoshlik orqali qonuniylashtirilgan.

economy.en: Caravan trade and craft production concentrated in Samarkand and Herat.
economy.uz: Samarqand va Hirotda jamlangan karvon savdosi va hunarmandchilik.

culture.en: Persian and Chagatai literature, miniature painting, the poetry of Alisher Navoi.
culture.uz: Fors va chig‘atoy adabiyoti, miniatyura san’ati, Alisher Navoiy she’riyati.

military.en: Timur's campaigns reached Delhi, Damascus and Ankara (1402).
military.uz: Temur yurishlari Dehli, Damashq va Anqaragacha (1402) yetgan.

achievements.en: Registan-era architecture, Gur-e-Amir, Ulugh Beg's star catalogue.
achievements.uz: Registon me’morchiligi, Go‘ri Amir, Ulug‘bek yulduzlar jadvali.

decline.en: Fragmentation among princes; Herat fell to the Shaybanids in 1507.
decline.uz: Shahzodalar o‘rtasida parchalanish; Hirot 1507-yilda Shayboniylarga o‘tgan.

region.uz: Sharqiy O‘rta yer dengizi, Anadolu, Bolqon

summary.en: The eastern continuation of Rome, centred on Constantinople, until its capture by the Ottomans in 1453.
summary.uz: Rimning sharqiy davomchisi; 1453-yilda Usmonlilar tomonidan egallangunga qadar Konstantinopol markaz bo‘lgan.

political.en: An autocratic emperor with a large bureaucracy, closely tied to the Orthodox Church.
political.uz: Pravoslav cherkovi bilan chambarchas bog‘liq, katta byurokratiyaga ega mutlaq imperator.

economy.en: Constantinople as a trade hub; the gold solidus as a stable currency for centuries.
economy.uz: Konstantinopol savdo markazi; oltin solid asrlar davomida barqaror valyuta bo‘lgan.

culture.en: Greek-language scholarship, icons and mosaics, Hagia Sophia.
culture.uz: Yunon tilidagi ilm, ikona va mozaikalar, Ayasofya.

military.en: Thematic armies, fortifications and 'Greek fire' at sea.
military.uz: Fema qo‘shinlari, istehkomlar va dengizda «yunon olovi».

achievements.en: The Justinian Code; preservation of classical Greek texts.
achievements.uz: Yustinian kodeksi; mumtoz yunon matnlarini saqlab qolish.

decline.en: Losses to Seljuks, the Fourth Crusade (1204), and the Ottoman conquest in 1453.
decline.uz: Saljuqiylarga yo‘qotishlar, To‘rtinchi salib yurishi (1204) va 1453-yildagi Usmonli istilosi.

region.en: Anatolia, Balkans, Middle East, North Africa
region.uz: Anadolu, Bolqon, Yaqin Sharq, Shimoliy Afrika

summary.en: A dynasty that ruled for over six centuries, bridging Europe, Asia and Africa until its abolition in 1922.
summary.uz: Olti asrdan ortiq hukm surgan, 1922-yilda tugatilgunga qadar Yevropa, Osiyo va Afrikani bog‘lagan sulola.

political.en: Sultanate with a grand vizier and provincial governors; late reforms (Tanzimat) modernised the state.
political.uz: Buyuk vazir va viloyat hokimlariga ega sultonlik; kech davr islohotlari (Tanzimat) davlatni zamonaviylashtirgan.

economy.en: Control of routes between Europe and Asia; timar land grants.
economy.uz: Yevropa va Osiyo o‘rtasidagi yo‘llar nazorati; timar yer berish tizimi.

culture.en: Architecture of Sinan, calligraphy, a multi-confessional millet system.
culture.uz: Me’mor Sinan asarlari, xattotlik, ko‘p konfessiyali millat tizimi.

military.en: Janissary infantry and early gunpowder artillery.
military.uz: Yangicheri piyoda qo‘shini va ilk o‘qotar artilleriya.

achievements.en: Süleymaniye Mosque; a legal code (kanun) alongside Islamic law.
achievements.uz: Sulaymoniya masjidi; shariat bilan bir qatorda qonunnoma (qonun).

decline.en: Territorial losses in the 19th century; defeat in WWI; sultanate abolished in 1922.
decline.uz: XIX asrdagi hududiy yo‘qotishlar; Birinchi jahon urushidagi mag‘lubiyat; sultonlik 1922-yilda bekor qilingan.

summary.en: Founded by Babur of Andijan after the First Battle of Panipat; patron of the Taj Mahal and Indo-Persian culture.
summary.uz: Andijonlik Bobur tomonidan Panipatdagi birinchi jangdan so‘ng asos solingan; Tojmahal va hind-fors madaniyatining homiysi.

political.en: Centralised rule through the mansabdari ranking of nobles.
political.uz: Zodagonlarni mansabdorlik darajalari orqali markazlashgan boshqaruv.

economy.en: A large agrarian economy; textiles traded across the Indian Ocean.
economy.uz: Katta agrar iqtisodiyot; to‘qimachilik mahsulotlari Hind okeani bo‘ylab savdo qilingan.

culture.en: Indo-Persian painting and architecture; Babur's memoir, the Baburnama.
culture.uz: Hind-fors rangtasviri va me’morchiligi; Boburning «Boburnoma» asari.

military.en: Cavalry combined with field artillery, used decisively at Panipat in 1526.
military.uz: Otliq qo‘shin va dala artilleriyasi; 1526-yilda Panipatda hal qiluvchi qo‘llanilgan.

achievements.en: The Taj Mahal, Red Fort and Fatehpur Sikri.

decline.en: Weakened after Aurangzeb; ended by the British after the 1857 uprising.
decline.uz: Avrangzebdan keyin zaiflashgan; 1857-yilgi qo‘zg‘olondan so‘ng inglizlar tomonidan tugatilgan.

summary.en: Timurid ruler of Samarkand who built a great observatory and compiled the Zij-i Sultani star catalogue.
summary.uz: Samarqandda buyuk rasadxona qurgan va «Ziji Ko‘ragoniy» yulduzlar jadvalini tuzgan temuriy hukmdor.

context.en: Grandson of Timur, he governed Samarkand for about four decades during the reign of his father Shah Rukh.
context.uz: Temurning nabirasi; otasi Shohrux hukmronligi davrida qariyb qirq yil Samarqandni boshqargan.

summary.en: Scholar of Baghdad's House of Wisdom whose treatise gave us the word 'algebra'; 'algorithm' derives from his name.
summary.uz: Bag‘doddagi «Bayt ul-hikma» olimi; uning risolasi «algebra» so‘ziga, ismi esa «algoritm» atamasiga asos bo‘ldi.

context.en: Worked in Abbasid Baghdad during the translation movement under Caliph al-Ma'mun.
context.uz: Xalifa al-Ma’mun davridagi tarjima harakati paytida Abbosiylar Bag‘dodida ishlagan.

summary.en: Born near Bukhara; his Canon of Medicine remained a standard medical text in Europe and the Islamic world for centuries.
summary.uz: Buxoro yaqinida tug‘ilgan; uning «Tib qonunlari» asari asrlar davomida Yevropa va Islom olamida asosiy tibbiy darslik bo‘lgan.

context.en: Lived through the decline of the Samanid state and served several rulers in Iran.
context.uz: Somoniylar davlatining tanazzuli davrida yashab, Erondagi bir necha hukmdorga xizmat qilgan.

summary.en: Conquered Media, Lydia and Babylon; his reign is known from the Cyrus Cylinder and Greek historians.
summary.uz: Midiya, Lidiya va Bobilni zabt etgan; hukmronligi «Kir silindri» va yunon tarixchilari orqali ma’lum.

context.en: Rose in the 6th century BCE when Media, Lydia and Babylon were the region's great powers.
context.uz: Mil. avv. VI asrda, Midiya, Lidiya va Bobil mintaqaning yirik davlatlari bo‘lgan paytda yuksalgan.

role.en: Conqueror, founder of the Timurid dynasty

summary.en: Built an empire from Samarkand across Central and Western Asia; his campaigns were also among the most destructive of the era.
summary.uz: Samarqanddan Markaziy va G‘arbiy Osiyo bo‘ylab davlat barpo etgan; yurishlari o‘z davrining eng vayronkorlaridan ham bo‘lgan.

context.en: Emerged from the fragmented Chagatai Khanate in the 1360s.
context.uz: 1360-yillarda parchalangan Chig‘atoy ulusi sharoitida maydonga chiqqan.

summary.en: Renaissance polymath of the Mona Lisa and The Last Supper, whose notebooks span anatomy, flight and hydraulics.
summary.uz: «Mona Liza» va «So‘nggi kechlik» muallifi, daftarlarida anatomiya, parvoz va gidravlikani o‘rgangan Uyg‘onish davri qomusiy olimi.

context.en: Worked in Florence, Milan and Rome during the Italian Renaissance, and died in France.
context.uz: Italiya Uyg‘onish davrida Florensiya, Milan va Rimda ishlagan, Fransiyada vafot etgan.

summary.en: Upper and Lower Egypt are joined under the first dynasty.
summary.uz: Yuqori va Quyi Misr birinchi sulola ostida birlashadi.

summary.en: Babylonian law code inscribed on a basalt stele.
summary.uz: Bazalt ustunga o‘yilgan Bobil qonunlar to‘plami.

summary.en: Cyrus II overthrows the Median king Astyages.
summary.uz: Kir II Midiya shohi Astiagni ag‘daradi.

summary.en: Octavian receives the title Augustus; the Principate begins.
summary.uz: Oktavian «Avgust» unvonini oladi; Principat boshlanadi.

summary.en: Church council convened by Constantine I in Anatolia.
summary.uz: Konstantin I Anadoluda chaqirgan cherkov sobori.

summary.en: Abbasid and Tang forces clash near the Talas River in Central Asia.
summary.uz: Abbosiylar va Tan qo‘shinlari Markaziy Osiyodagi Talas daryosi yaqinida to‘qnashadi.

summary.en: Baghdad becomes a centre of translation and science under al-Ma'mun.
summary.uz: Al-Ma’mun davrida Bag‘dod tarjima va ilm markaziga aylanadi.

summary.en: A kurultai unites the Mongol tribes.
summary.uz: Qurultoy mo‘g‘ul qabilalarini birlashtiradi.

summary.en: King John of England agrees to limits on royal power.
summary.uz: Angliya qiroli Ioann qirollik hokimiyatini cheklashga rozi bo‘ladi.

summary.en: Stone city at the centre of a gold-trading state in southern Africa.
summary.uz: Janubiy Afrikadagi oltin savdosi davlatining markazi bo‘lgan tosh shahar.

summary.en: The Mexica found their capital on Lake Texcoco.
summary.uz: Mexikalar Teskoko ko‘lida poytaxtlariga asos soladi.

summary.en: Timur defeats Ottoman Sultan Bayezid I.
summary.uz: Amir Temur Usmonli sultoni Boyazid I ni mag‘lub etadi.

summary.en: Construction of the great observatory in Samarkand (c. 1420s).
summary.uz: Samarqanddagi buyuk rasadxona quriladi (taxm. 1420-yillar).

summary.en: Ottoman forces under Mehmed II take the Byzantine capital.
summary.uz: Mehmed II boshchiligidagi Usmonli qo‘shini Vizantiya poytaxtini egallaydi.

summary.en: Movable-type printing spreads across Europe.
summary.uz: Harf terish usulidagi bosmaxona Yevropa bo‘ylab tarqaladi.

summary.en: Beginning of sustained European contact with the Americas.
summary.uz: Yevropa va Amerika o‘rtasidagi doimiy aloqalarning boshlanishi.

summary.en: Babur defeats Ibrahim Lodi, founding Mughal rule in India.
summary.uz: Bobur Ibrohim Lo‘diyni yengib, Hindistonda Boburiylar hukmronligiga asos soladi.

summary.en: The Dutch navigator becomes the first recorded European to sight the island.
summary.uz: Gollandiyalik dengizchi orolni ko‘rgan ilk qayd etilgan yevropalikka aylanadi.

title.uz: Kuk Avstraliyaning sharqiy qirg‘og‘ini xaritaga tushiradi

summary.en: James Cook's voyage maps the eastern coastline of Australia.
summary.uz: Jeyms Kukning sayohati Avstraliyaning sharqiy qirg‘oqlarini xaritaga tushiradi.

summary.en: A defining moment of the French Revolution.
summary.uz: Fransuz inqilobining hal qiluvchi lahzasi.

title.en: On the Origin of Species published

summary.en: Charles Darwin sets out the theory of evolution by natural selection.
summary.uz: Charlz Darvin tabiiy tanlanish orqali evolyutsiya nazariyasini bayon qiladi.

summary.en: Imperial rule is restored in Japan, launching rapid modernisation.
summary.uz: Yaponiyada imperator hokimiyati tiklanib, tezkor modernizatsiya boshlanadi.

summary.en: European powers set rules for the colonial partition of Africa.
summary.uz: Yevropa davlatlari Afrikani mustamlakaga bo‘lish qoidalarini belgilaydi.

summary.en: A coin-operated phonograph, forerunner of the jukebox, debuts at the Palais Royale Saloon in San Francisco.
summary.uz: Jukeboksning ajdodi — tangali fonograf San-Fransiskodagi Palais Royale saloonida namoyish etiladi.

summary.en: Austria-Hungary declares war on Serbia.
summary.uz: Avstriya-Vengriya Serbiyaga urush e’lon qiladi.

summary.en: The New York Times reports Edwin Hubble's evidence that spiral 'nebulae' are galaxies beyond the Milky Way.
summary.uz: The New York Times Edvin Xabblning spiral «tumanliklar» Somon yo‘lidan tashqaridagi galaktikalar ekanini e’lon qiladi.

summary.en: Henry Luce relaunches LIFE as a weekly devoted to photojournalism.
summary.uz: Genri Lyus LIFEni fotojurnalistikaga bag‘ishlangan haftalik sifatida qayta chiqaradi.

summary.en: Germany invades Poland.
summary.uz: Germaniya Polshaga bostirib kiradi.

summary.en: British rule ends with partition into two states.
summary.uz: Britaniya hukmronligi ikki davlatga bo‘linish bilan tugaydi.

summary.en: The first artificial satellite orbits the Earth.
summary.uz: Birinchi sun’iy yo‘ldosh Yer orbitasiga chiqadi.

summary.en: Humans walk on the Moon for the first time.
summary.uz: Inson ilk bor Oy yuzasida qadam tashlaydi.

summary.en: East Germany opens its border crossings.
summary.uz: Sharqiy Germaniya chegara o‘tish joylarini ochadi.

summary.en: Uzbekistan declares independence from the USSR.
summary.uz: O‘zbekiston SSSRdan mustaqilligini e’lon qiladi.

countries.official: Nation of Brunei, Abode of Peace

overview.en: Egypt hosts one of the world's oldest continuous civilizations, organised around the Nile.
overview.uz: Misr Nil atrofida shakllangan dunyodagi eng qadimiy uzluksiz sivilizatsiyalardan biriga ega.

text.en: Predynastic cultures such as Naqada developed along the Nile in the 4th millennium BCE.
text.uz: Mil. avv. IV ming yillikda Nil bo‘yida Naqada kabi sulolagacha madaniyatlar rivojlangan.

text.en: Pharaonic Egypt lasted from c. 3100 BCE until Roman annexation in 30 BCE.
text.uz: Fir’avnlar Misri taxm. mil. avv. 3100-yildan mil. avv. 30-yilda Rimga qo‘shilgunga qadar davom etgan.

text.en: Arab conquest (641) was followed by the Fatimids, who founded Cairo in 969, and the Mamluks.
text.uz: Arab istilosidan (641) keyin 969-yilda Qohirani barpo etgan Fotimiylar va Mamluklar hukm surgan.

text.en: Ottoman province from 1517; the Suez Canal opened in 1869; British occupation from 1882.
text.uz: 1517-yildan Usmonli viloyati; Suvaysh kanali 1869-yilda ochilgan; 1882-yildan Britaniya istilosi.

text.en: Nominal independence in 1922; a republic since 1953.
text.uz: 1922-yilda rasmiy mustaqillik; 1953-yildan respublika.

countries.official: Territory of the French Southern and Antarctic Lands
Hong Kong Special Administrative Region of the People's Republic of China

overview.en: Iran's plateau has been home to empires from the Achaemenids to the Safavids, with a rich Persian literary tradition.
overview.uz: Eron yassitog‘i Ahamoniylardan Safaviylargacha bo‘lgan imperiyalar vatani, boy fors adabiy an’anasiga ega.

text.en: Elam, centred at Susa, was among the earliest states of the region.
text.uz: Suza markazli Elam mintaqadagi eng qadimgi davlatlardan biri bo‘lgan.

text.en: Achaemenid, Parthian and Sasanian empires ruled from the 6th century BCE to 651 CE.
text.uz: Mil. avv. VI asrdan milodiy 651-yilgacha Ahamoniylar, Parfiya va Sosoniylar imperiyalari hukm surgan.

text.en: After the Arab conquest, Persian culture revived; Seljuks, Mongols and Timurids followed.
text.uz: Arab istilosidan so‘ng fors madaniyati qayta tiklangan; keyin Saljuqiylar, mo‘g‘ullar va Temuriylar kelgan.

text.en: The Safavids (from 1501) made Twelver Shi'ism the state religion; Qajars ruled 1789–1925.
text.uz: Safaviylar (1501-yildan) o‘n ikki imomli shialikni davlat diniga aylantirgan; Qojorlar 1789–1925-yillarda hukm surgan.

text.en: Pahlavi monarchy 1925–1979; the Islamic Republic was established after the 1979 revolution.
text.uz: 1925–1979-yillar Pahlaviylar monarxiyasi; 1979-yilgi inqilobdan so‘ng Islom Respublikasi tashkil topgan.

overview.en: The Italian peninsula was the centre of the Roman world and later the cradle of the Renaissance.
overview.uz: Italiya yarimoroli Rim dunyosining markazi, keyinroq esa Uyg‘onish davrining beshigi bo‘lgan.

text.en: Etruscan, Italic and Greek colonial cultures shared the peninsula in the 1st millennium BCE.
text.uz: Mil. avv. I ming yillikda yarimorolda etrusk, italik va yunon mustamlaka madaniyatlari mavjud bo‘lgan.

text.en: Rome grew from a city-state to rule the Mediterranean; the western empire ended in 476 CE.
text.uz: Rim shahar-davlatdan O‘rta yer dengizini boshqaruvchi davlatga aylangan; g‘arbiy imperiya milodiy 476-yilda tugagan.

text.en: Divided among Lombards, Byzantines, the Papal States and city republics like Venice and Florence.
text.uz: Langobardlar, Vizantiya, Papa davlati hamda Venetsiya va Florensiya kabi shahar-respublikalar o‘rtasida bo‘lingan.

text.en: The Renaissance began in Florence; unification (Risorgimento) produced the Kingdom of Italy in 1861.
text.uz: Uyg‘onish davri Florensiyada boshlangan; birlashuv (Risorjimento) natijasida 1861-yilda Italiya qirolligi tuzilgan.

text.en: Fascist rule 1922–1943; a republic by referendum in 1946; founding member of the EEC.
text.uz: 1922–1943-yillar fashistlar hukmronligi; 1946-yilda referendum orqali respublika; YEIH asoschilaridan biri.

overview.en: Mongolia's steppe gave rise to successive nomadic empires, culminating in the empire of Genghis Khan.
overview.uz: Mo‘g‘uliston dashtlari ketma-ket ko‘chmanchi imperiyalarni, eng avvalo Chingizxon imperiyasini vujudga keltirgan.

text.en: Bronze Age herding cultures left deer stones and burial mounds across the steppe.
text.uz: Bronza davri chorvador madaniyatlari dasht bo‘ylab bug‘u toshlari va qo‘rg‘onlar qoldirgan.

text.en: The Xiongnu confederation (from the 3rd century BCE) rivalled Han China.
text.uz: Xunnu ittifoqi (mil. avv. III asrdan) Xan Xitoyi bilan raqobatlashgan.

text.en: Temujin united the tribes in 1206; the Mongol Empire became the largest contiguous empire.
text.uz: Temuchin 1206-yilda qabilalarni birlashtirgan; Mo‘g‘ul imperiyasi eng yirik yaxlit imperiyaga aylangan.

text.en: Under Qing rule from the late 17th century; declared independence in 1911.
text.uz: XVII asr oxiridan Sin sulolasi hukmronligida; 1911-yilda mustaqillik e’lon qilingan.

text.en: Mongolian People's Republic from 1924; democratic transition in 1990.
text.uz: 1924-yildan Mo‘g‘uliston Xalq Respublikasi; 1990-yilda demokratik o‘tish.

overview.en: Anatolia bridges Europe and Asia; it was home to the Hittites, Byzantium and the Ottoman Empire.
overview.uz: Anadolu Yevropa va Osiyoni bog‘laydi; u xettlar, Vizantiya va Usmonli imperiyasi vatani bo‘lgan.

text.en: Göbekli Tepe and Çatalhöyük are among the earliest monumental and urban sites known.
text.uz: Go‘bekli-Tepa va Chatalxo‘yuk ma’lum bo‘lgan eng qadimgi monumental va shahar yodgorliklaridan.

text.en: The Hittite kingdom, Greek cities of Ionia, and later Roman provinces.
text.uz: Xett podsholigi, Ioniya yunon shaharlari, keyinroq Rim viloyatlari.

text.en: Byzantine heartland; Seljuk victory at Manzikert (1071); Ottoman rise from c. 1299.
text.uz: Vizantiya markazi; Saljuqiylarning Malazgirtdagi g‘alabasi (1071); taxm. 1299-yildan Usmonlilarning yuksalishi.

text.en: Ottoman capital at Constantinople from 1453; reform and decline in the 19th century.
text.uz: 1453-yildan Usmonli poytaxti Konstantinopolda; XIX asrda islohotlar va tanazzul.

text.en: The Republic of Turkey was proclaimed on 29 October 1923.
text.uz: Turkiya Respublikasi 1923-yil 29-oktabrda e’lon qilingan.

overview.en: At the heart of Central Asia, the lands of modern Uzbekistan — Sogdiana, Bactria and Khwarazm — sat on the Silk Road for over two millennia.
overview.uz: Markaziy Osiyoning qoq markazida joylashgan bugungi O‘zbekiston hududi — So‘g‘d, Baqtriya va Xorazm — ikki ming yildan ortiq Ipak yo‘lida bo‘lgan.

text.en: Bronze Age oasis settlements developed in the Amu Darya and Zarafshan valleys.
text.uz: Bronza davrida Amudaryo va Zarafshon vodiylarida voha manzilgohlari rivojlangan.

text.en: Sogdiana and Bactria were Achaemenid satrapies, later conquered by Alexander (329–327 BCE) and partly ruled by the Kushans.
text.uz: So‘g‘d va Baqtriya Ahamoniylar satrapiyalari bo‘lgan, keyin Aleksandr tomonidan bosib olingan (mil. avv. 329–327) va qisman Kushonlar hukmronligida bo‘lgan.

text.en: After the Arab conquest, Bukhara flourished under the Samanids; Samarkand became Timur's capital in 1370.
text.uz: Arab istilosidan so‘ng Buxoro Somoniylar davrida gullab-yashnagan; Samarqand 1370-yilda Temur poytaxtiga aylangan.

text.en: The khanates of Bukhara, Khiva and Kokand were absorbed by the Russian Empire in the 1860s–1870s.
text.uz: Buxoro, Xiva va Qo‘qon xonliklari 1860–1870-yillarda Rossiya imperiyasi tarkibiga qo‘shilgan.

text.en: The Uzbek SSR was formed in 1924; independence was declared on 1 September 1991.
text.uz: O‘zbekiston SSR 1924-yilda tuzilgan; mustaqillik 1991-yil 1-sentabrda e’lon qilingan.
